t_advice_summary_textbox.text: i selected the same colour until i got to 0 then switched to the other until that went to 0, it seemed to work pretty well.

vb_textbox.text: I found paying attention to which side the colour was on would possible show a pattern. Yellow/brown, blue/red, pink/purple and orange/green, for example in some cases it seemed yellow on the right wouldn't give many mushrooms but would give more on the left.
